title: FrostSMP modpack
body:
# 🛡️ FrostSMP Official Modpack
The official performance and utility suite for FrostSMP Hardcore. This pack is designed to provide a fair, smooth, and competitive experience while strictly adhering to the server regulations.

## 🚀 Features:
- Ultimate Performance: Powered by Sodium and Lithium to ensure high FPS during intense PvP and raids.
- Visual Enhancements: Includes Iris Shaders support and various fixes for better visibility and game feel.
- Utility & UI: Optimized HUD and inventory interactions that stay within the fair-play rules.
- Hardcore Ready: Pre-configured for the best experience on FrostSMP—no extra setup required.

## ⚠️ Important:
This modpack is strictly maintained. The use of Xaero’s Minimap, Pie Charting (F3+Shift), and other unauthorized mods listed in the #informatie channel will result in a permanent ban.

Play Fair. Stay Sharp.
